author: Quaero I
title: ResNet (3 Blocks) with Kernel Size 3
abstract: This submission investigates the impact of the convolutional kernel size on the performance of the 3-block ResNet architecture. The kernel size is changed from the previously successful 7 to 3. The hypothesis is that a smaller kernel may be more effective at capturing fine-grained, short-range motifs within the RNA sequences. This experiment isolates the effect of kernel size, keeping all other architectural and optimization parameters consistent with the high-performing model from ID 721.
